bearing.model.v1alpha1.Binding.schema.js.description:
Binding is one row of an alias's binding timeline: the subject the alias
 maps to over one valid-time interval (docs/spec/data-model.md,
 "Bindings"). An id alias has one row with no valid-time bounds.

^(recordedAt)$.description: Set by the store: when the row was recorded.

^(retractedAt)$.description: Set by the store: when an apply replaced the row.

^(subjectId)$.description:
The subject as written. Empty for a released name that doesn't
 redirect. ResolveKey canonicalizes it through merges.

^(validFrom)$.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

^(validTo)$.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

recorded_at.description: Set by the store: when the row was recorded.

released.description: The name is released here; subject_id, if set, is where it redirects.

retracted_at.description: Set by the store: when an apply replaced the row.

subject_id.description:
The subject as written. Empty for a released name that doesn't
 redirect. ResolveKey canonicalizes it through merges.

tentative.description: Written by a reference when minting a placeholder.

valid_from.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

valid_to.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Binding.schema.js.title: Binding

bearing.model.v1alpha1.BindingTimeline.s.description: BindingTimeline is the complete binding timeline of one alias.

bindings.description: Rows that don't overlap in valid time. Their alias must match.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.BindingTimeline.s.title: Binding Timeline

bearing.model.v1alpha1.ChangeSet.schema..description:
Every timeline item (bindings, supports, facts) replaces the current timeline of its series: rows equal to a current row
 are kept, current rows not repeated are retracted, and new rows are
 recorded. An empty timeline retracts the series.

^(baseRecordedAt)$.description:
The store's head (the latest apply's recorded_at) the ChangeSet was
 computed from. Absent for an empty store. Apply fails as stale if the
 head has moved.

^(eventId)$.description: The event applied. Required; the store applies each event ID once.

^(recordedAt)$.description: Set by the store: this apply's record time.

base_recorded_at.description:
The store's head (the latest apply's recorded_at) the ChangeSet was
 computed from. Absent for an empty store. Apply fails as stale if the
 head has moved.

event_id.description: The event applied. Required; the store applies each event ID once.

recorded_at.description: Set by the store: this apply's record time.

unmerges.description:
Un-merges. Each target is resolved against the state before the
 ChangeSet, not after the un-merges listed before it.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.ChangeSet.schema..title:
ChangeSet is one event's writes. Subject IDs anywhere in it may be refs
 ("new:<label>") naming a subject a Mint or Unmerge in the same ChangeSet
 creates; the store replaces them with the minted IDs. Items apply in this
 order: mints, unmerge targets, bindings, merges, unmerges, then the rest.
 Merges apply in order, each seeing the ones before it. Un-merges don't:
 every un-merge's target is resolved against the state before the
 ChangeSet, and two un-merges may not claim the same merge record or
 subject.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Evidence.schema.j.description: Evidence says where a person can check an observation's claims.

url.description: A link to the claims in the source.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Evidence.schema.j.title: Evidence

bearing.model.v1alpha1.FactObject.schema.description:
FactObject is a fact's object: { "subject_id" } for a relation, or
 { "type", "value" } for an attribute.

type.description: An attribute's value type. Set with value.
type.title: Value Type

value.description:
An attribute's value, in canonical form. Set with type. string and time
 are strings (time in the 6-digit canonical form), float a number, bool
 a boolean, json any JSON value.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.FactObject.schema.title: Fact Object

bearing.model.v1alpha1.FactSpan.schema.j.description: FactSpan is a fact's status over one valid-time interval.

^(statusReason)$.description: The status step that decided it.
^(statusReason)$.title: Status Reason

^(validFrom)$.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

^(validTo)$.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

status_reason.description: The status step that decided it.
status_reason.title: Status Reason

valid_from.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

valid_to.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.FactSpan.schema.j.title: Fact Span

bearing.model.v1alpha1.FactTimeline.sche.description:
FactTimeline is one fact's complete status timeline. Valid times no span
 covers have status none.

spans.description: Spans that don't overlap in valid time.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.FactTimeline.sche.title: Fact Timeline

bearing.model.v1alpha1.JournalEntry.sche.description:
JournalEntry is one apply in a store's change journal (not the audit log,
 ADR 8): the ChangeSet as applied, with the store-set fields filled in,
 and what the apply decided. The reference store's backup body is its
 journal, one entry per record; replay re-decides each entry and fails if
 the outcome differs.

^(changeSet)$.description: The ChangeSet with recorded_at, minted IDs and un-merge targets set.

change_set.description: The ChangeSet with recorded_at, minted IDs and un-merge targets set.

merges.description: The merge records the apply created, in order.

minted.description: The subjects minted, split mints included, as minted.

subjects.description: Each ref in the ChangeSet and the subject it named.

unmerges.description: Each un-merge's outcome, in the ChangeSet's order.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.JournalEntry.sche.title: Journal Entry

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Merge.schema.json.description:
Merge joins two active subjects of one kind; the lower subject_id
 survives (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Merge").

^(subjectIds)$.description: The two subjects, in any order.

evidence.description: The supports that are the evidence.

rule.description: The rule that merges them. Required.
rule.title: Merge Rule

subject_ids.description: The two subjects, in any order.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Merge.schema.json.title: Merge

bearing.model.v1alpha1.MergeRecord.schem.description:
MergeRecord is one merge of two subjects, and its un-merge if there was
 one (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Merge" step 6).

^(eventId)$.description: The event whose apply merged them.

^(mergedAliases)$.description: The merged subject's aliases when the merge was recorded, sorted.

^(mergedId)$.description: The subject merged into the survivor.

^(survivorAliases)$.description: The survivor's aliases when the merge was recorded, sorted.

^(survivorId)$.description: The lower subject_id, which stays active.

^(unmergeEventId)$.description: The event whose apply un-merged them.

^(unmergedAt)$.description: When an un-merge reactivated merged_id; absent while merged.

event_id.description: The event whose apply merged them.

evidence.description: The supports that were the evidence.

merged_aliases.description: The merged subject's aliases when the merge was recorded, sorted.

merged_id.description: The subject merged into the survivor.

survivor_aliases.description: The survivor's aliases when the merge was recorded, sorted.

survivor_id.description: The lower subject_id, which stays active.

unmerge_event_id.description: The event whose apply un-merged them.

unmerged_at.description: When an un-merge reactivated merged_id; absent while merged.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.MergeRecord.schem.title: Merge Record

^(subjectId)$.description: Set by the store: the minted ID.

ref.description: The ref ("new:<label>") the rest of the ChangeSet uses for it.

rule.description: observation or reference; split comes from an Unmerge.
rule.title: Mint Rule

subject_id.description: Set by the store: the minted ID.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.MintedBy.schema.j.description: MintedBy records the event and rule that minted a subject.

^(eventId)$.description: The event whose apply minted the subject.

event_id.description: The event whose apply minted the subject.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.MintedBy.schema.j.title: Minted By

bearing.model.v1alpha1.StateEntry.schema.description:
StateEntry is one entry of the resolver's own state: ordering keys,
 watermarks, sync progress and the like. It is primary state, backed up
 with the graph, and versioned by record time like everything else.

key.description:
The resolver's key. Any segment between "/" that is a ref ("new:<label>")
 is replaced by the subject the ref names, so a key can name a subject
 the same ChangeSet creates.

value.description: The value; absent deletes the entry.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.StateEntry.schema.title: State Entry

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Subject.schema.js.description: Subject is a thing Bearing knows about.

^(mergedInto)$.description: For merged subjects, the subject it was merged into.

^(mintedAt)$.description: When the core minted it (record time).

^(subjectId)$.description: UUIDv7, canonical lowercase text. Minted only by the core.

kind.description: A registered subject kind, fixed at mint.

merged_into.description: For merged subjects, the subject it was merged into.

minted_at.description: When the core minted it (record time).

status.description: Active or merged. Subjects are never deleted.
status.title: Subject Status

subject_id.description: UUIDv7, canonical lowercase text. Minted only by the core.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Subject.schema.js.title: Subject

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Support.schema.js.description:
Support is one support version: one source's state for a fact over one
 maximal valid-time interval, as recorded over one record-time interval.

^(confidencePpm)$.description: Always present in outputs; 0 is explicit.

^(lastConfirmedAt)$.description: Informational: the latest confirming claim's observed_at.

^(retractedAt)$.description: When an apply replaced it; absent while current.

^(validFrom)$.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

^(validTo)$.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

adapter.description: Adapter name and version, e.g. "github@0.2.0". Empty for derived supports.

confidence_ppm.description: Always present in outputs; 0 is explicit.

evidence.description: Where a person can check it.

last_confirmed_at.description: Informational: the latest confirming claim's observed_at.

qualifiers.description: De-duplicated qualifier objects, sorted by JCS bytes.

retracted_at.description: When an apply replaced it; absent while current.

source.description: The configured source, "manual" or a "core/..." source.

valid_from.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

valid_to.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

via.description: The aliases the claim was resolved through.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Support.schema.js.title: Support

bearing.model.v1alpha1.SupportTimeline.s.description:
SupportTimeline is one source's complete support timeline for one fact
 as written: its subject and object are kept as written, and reads
 canonicalize them (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Merge" step 3).

versions.description:
Live support versions that don't overlap in valid time. fact_id,
 recorded_at and retracted_at are set by the store; last_confirmed_at
 may change without a new version.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.SupportTimeline.s.title: Support Timeline

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Unmerge.schema.js.description:
Unmerge splits aliases off an active subject (docs/spec/data-model.md,
 "Un-merge").

^(targetId)$.description: Set by the store: the subject the aliases moved to.

aliases.description: A non-empty proper subset of A's aliases.

ref.description:
The ref ("new:<label>") the rest of the ChangeSet uses for the subject
 the aliases move to: the reactivated subject, or a split mint.
 Required, and unique among the ChangeSet's mints and un-merges.

target_id.description: Set by the store: the subject the aliases moved to.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Unmerge.schema.js.title: Unmerge

bearing.model.v1alpha1.UnmergeOutcome.sc.description: UnmergeOutcome is where one un-merge's aliases went.

^(targetId)$.description: The reactivated subject, or the split mint.

split.description: Set when the target is a split mint rather than a reactivated subject.

target_id.description: The reactivated subject, or the split mint.
